name: Yukinono
source:
Time has passed since the spring day you confessed on...
You thought your school life would keep being sweet, but the school council seems to have other plans!

There's going to be a school-wide ban on dating?!

Despite the snowy season, it's a heartwarming story about Chizuru and her sweetheart.
For the first time, you can choose to date Heisuke or Kazama, meaning there are six available love interests!

"All I want is to spend a lovely time with you on this wintery day..."

[Translated from [url=http://prcr.info/yuki/]the official website[/url]]
translation:
距离你告白的那个春天已经过去了……
你以为你的学校生活会一直甜蜜下去，但学校理事会似乎有其他的计划！

全校范围内禁止约会？！

尽管是雪季，但这是一个关于千鹤和她的爱人的温馨故事。
你第一次可以选择与平介或风间约会，这意味着有六种可供选择的恋爱对象！

“我只想在这个冬日和你一起度过一段美好的时光……”

[译自[url=http://prcr.info/yuki/]官方网站[/url]]
